resources.string: TapFlow Lite uses overlay permission only to display its own controls and editing surfaces over the applications you choose to automate. You can revoke it at any time in Android settings. It is not used to display third-party advertising.

TapFlow Lite uses Android AccessibilityService to execute the taps, swipes, and automation controls you configure. It may access window content and dispatch gestures as required for these features. Accessibility content is processed locally and is not transmitted to EEI14WAT.

You may cancel. Automation cannot run without this permission, while scenario editing remains available where supported.

Choose Agree and continue to open Android Accessibility settings.
Optional: Shows the notification while the application is running in order to easily return to the scenario selection screen.
This permission is mandatory for Klick\'r. It won\'t be able to work correctly without it.
